reasons: Claimed status is correct: the cited Section 7 (p0034-p0037) contains only liability caps, damage waivers and an attorneys'-fee waiver, with no defend/indemnify/hold-harmless obligation, so the Vendor indemnity required by INDEMN is genuinely absent.

The inserted Section 7(d) tracks the playbook model language closely (IP infringement allegation, breach of law, unauthorized access/disclosure of Company Confidential Information, gross negligence/wilful misconduct) and adds standard notice, defence-control (with a sensible no-adverse-settlement proviso) and cooperation mechanics, matching the preferred position.

Carving the indemnity out of Sections 7(a)-(c) is necessary and proportionate: without it the fee-cap and the attorneys'-fee waiver would swallow the new obligation, and 7(a) already uses the same exception technique for Paragraph 9.
Edit is minimal and correctly placed (appended after the last subsection of the limitation-of-liability section); no Company-side indemnity exists, so no narrowing was needed, as the comment states.
Comment is accurate, in-house voice, cites the playbook position and offers the fallback (customary IP exclusions and a 3x annual fees super-cap) without lecturing.

Minor drafting caveat to confirm on execution: the insertion references "Works" as the deliverables term, which was not among the resolved definitions provided (the excerpt uses "work product"/"Specifications"); if "Works" is not a defined term in Section 5, align the wording to the actual deliverables definition.
